rule.up_down: decisions newly flagged and newly unflagged at the threshold the verdict reads, both classes
rule.direction: exact two-sided sign test of up against down at 0.5, significant at p <= 0.05
rule.materiality: one-sided 95% lower bound on |up - down| / n above the margin, where the larger count's Clopper-Pearson lower bound π gives (up + down)(2π - 1) / n, and 0 without discordant pairs
rule.applies: only when the current rule says INCONCLUSIVE, which then becomes THRESHOLD STALE

bar.null: the rule fires in at most 2% of resamples
bar.path-switch null: the rule fires in at most 2% of resamples
bar.small shift: the rule fires in at most 5% of resamples
bar.gross: the combined verdict equals the current one in every resample
bar.every row: the combined verdict differs from the current one only where INCONCLUSIVE becomes THRESHOLD STALE
bar.graded: none. Report the rate the rule fires, and how often that STALE goes against a population verdict of PASS
bar.synthetic null: the rule fires in at most 2% of resamples, at the selected margin, on null, fresh_engine_noise from experiments/phase1/gate/calibration.py with its seeds and sizes
bar.applies_to: rows with mode refit, on each split separately, as point estimates with exact 95% intervals reported beside them

selection: the smallest margin whose calibration rows meet every bar. Test at that margin is the replication and can't change the choice
ships_if: a margin is selected on calibration, the test rows meet every bar at it, and the synthetic nulls meet theirs. Otherwise the rule doesn't ship, the miss is published, and neither the margins nor the bars change
